name: Icon button
layerWhy: A button whose words are its name rather than its face; it keeps the same single-action promise as any button.
promise: Pressing it does the one thing its name says.
expectation: A familiar mark (close, edit, more) does what the mark always does.
evidence: Its name is read aloud and shown on hover (title, or a Primal tooltip); it acknowledges like any button.
behaviour: A square target the height of a control.
Quiet by default: it usually sits among others.
Shows its name as the browser title unless a Primal tooltip is on it.
context: For actions everyone knows by their mark, on a toolbar, in a corner, at the end of a row. Not for anything that needs its words to be understood.
relationships: It has a name like any button: "Close Panel".
Among icon buttons, the marks share one style and size.
accessibility: aria-label is required: the label input.
failures: Never a mark without a name.
Never a mark that means something else elsewhere in the product.
do: Use it for marks with one meaning everywhere.
Give it a tooltip when the mark alone could be read two ways.
dont: An icon button for a rare or unfamiliar action.
Two marks that look alike for different actions.

usage.markup:
<button primalIconButton type="button" label="Close Panel">
  <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">…</svg>
</button>
